title: AskUserQuestion
description: AI coach structured multiple-choice question payload for client UI rendering and hydration.

type.description: Discriminator for fenced block parsing or persisted tool inputs

questions.description: Questions to ask the user. Use 1-4 questions. Each question must have a stable id, a short header, and 2-4 options.

id.description: Stable question id used to map the answer, for example weekly_days or long_day.

header.description: Very short chip label shown above the question, ideally 2-12 characters.

question.description: The full question to ask the user. Keep it concise and specific.

multiSelect.description: Allow selecting multiple options when choices are not mutually exclusive.

options.description: Available answer choices. Use 2-4 options. Put the recommended option first and include the trade-off in description.

value.description: Stable, unique option identifier, e.g. restart_training. Required in addition to the visible label.

preview.description: Optional preview content for future rich UI use.

source.description: Optional identifier for analytics or debugging, for example plan-builder.

skill.description: Optional active skill name, for example plan-builder.
